entry.title: How a fleet of AI agents built 121 bid calculators nobody asked for
entry.summary: Five sensible rules, no memory between runs, and a router ranking on self-assigned scores: how unattended coding agents built a calculator glut, and the fix.

entry.title: Throughput per unit of supervision: lessons from 12,000 commits by unattended coding agents
entry.summary: Getting coding agents to merge 200 pull requests a day was easy. Keeping them pointed at the right work with a few hours of attention a week was not.
